title: Delicious Chicken Kebabs
description: A classic Turkish dish featuring marinated chicken cooked to perfection on skewers. Serve with your favorite sides for a flavorful meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Add the chicken and mix to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the chicken, red bell pepper, and yellow onion onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the kebabs hot with pita bread on the side.
